title: The Buick GS Is the Muscle Car the Market Keeps Underpricing, and Hagerty’s Data Is Starting to Notice - Yahoo Autos
content: Buick's Gran Sport is the muscle car the market keeps forgetting to price. In its October Price Guide update, Hagerty reports 1968–72 Buick GS 400 and GS 455 values up 4% on average, the first meaningful gain after several quarters of declines. A single quarter is a modest signal. But it lands on a family of cars whose spread, from entry level to trophy, may be the widest in the segment. Our view: the GS is the clearest example of a muscle car that was priced for what it was not. It was never a Hemi or a Boss. It was a fast, heavy, torque-rich car from a company that did not shout, and the market is slowly learning to read that as a virtue. According to Hagerty's review, #2 (excellent) values across the 1968–72 GS 400 and GS 455 run from $27,700 for a 1972 GS 455 Sport Coupe to $129,000 for a 1970 GS 455 Stage I convertible. That is a spread of more than four and a half times inside one model family. Few cars in the hobby offer a collector a seat at the table for under $30,000 and a blue-chip option at more than $120,000 without changing badges. The 455 Stage 1 engine in a 1970 Buick Gran Sport. The air cleaner decal is visible, but the block code, casting numbers and carburetor number are what verify the engine. Photo: Mr.choppers via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 The expensive end of the GS range is governed by the same forces as every other muscle car: engine, body style, documentation. A Stage 1 convertible is a different asset from a 1972 coupe, and the gap in Hagerty's numbers reflects it. That is why buyers should be careful about reading the 4% as a rising tide. It is an average over cars that behave very differently. We have seen how much the details matter. As we explained in our report on a 1970 Buick GSX with no VIN of its own, a GSX cannot be proved from the VIN alone, and a genuine Stage 1 GS is a valuable car but not a GSX. The Stage 1 decal on an air cleaner is not proof of anything. The verification lies in the block code, casting numbers and carburetor number. Two readings are reasonable. The first is simple recovery: after several quarters of declines, buyers see a car with a strong build story priced well below its Detroit rivals. The second is the broader pattern we describe in our look at the October Price Guide, where cars with a verifiable story hold up while those depending on a single feature slip. The Buick sits between those camps. Its story is real but quiet. There is also the Buick halo. The turbocharged era that followed, led by the Grand National and GNX, gave the brand a performance credibility that older Gran Sports can borrow. Our list of the most expensive Buick GNXs ever sold shows how seriously collectors take that lineage once a car carries the right paperwork. Be skeptical of any claim of Stage 1 or GSX without documentation, and look to the numbers on the engine rather than the decal. Decide whether you are buying a driver or an asset; at the low end, a clean GS 455 is among the least expensive entries to real big-block torque in the segment, while the top of the range demands a paper trail. And do not treat a 4% quarter as a trend. Hagerty's own data shows a rebound after several quarters of losses. The market has yet to prove it is more than a pause. Muscle car collectors have a habit of paying for noise. The Buick GS may be the first place the market stops. Sign up for the Collector Car Market Brief. title: 2027 Federal Pay Raise: Up to 6.7% for Some as OPM Expands Special Rates - www.myfederalretirement.com
content:
Financial Planning Resources for Federal & Postal Employees Most civilian federal employees are headed for a 0% raise in January 2027, but the plan for law enforcement runs in the opposite direction. A Nov. 6 memo from the U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) says employees already on the law enforcement special rate tables will receive 3.8%, while employees newly brought under those tables will receive about 6.7%, subject to pay caps and agency review. The memo implements a directive in the president’s Aug. 26 alternative pay plan, which freezes General Schedule (GS) base and locality pay at 2026 levels while ordering a 3.8% increase for covered law enforcement personnel through special pay authorities. The memo is CPM 2026-13, signed by Veronica E. Hinton, Associate Director for Workforce Policy and Innovation, and addressed to agency chief human capital officers. Its title says “Request for Information,” but agencies only need to respond in two cases: to opt out of the new coverage, or to send questions or comments. Both are due Nov. 25, 2026. OPM organizes the law enforcement special rates into three groups of tables. Where an employee lands determines the increase. In January 2026, everyone received a 1% base pay increase. Employees on Tables L001 through L140 also received a 2.77% special rate increase, which brought their total to 3.8% (1.038 ÷ 1.01 − 1). Employees brought under the special rates in 2027 never received that 2.77%. Open Season is your chance to review your coverage before another year of premiums and out-of-pocket expenses. This FREE November 17 webinar breaks down 2027 plan changes, employee costs, government contributions, and FSA options. Save your seat today! OPM says the goal is common pay levels for covered law enforcement positions. Newly covered employees therefore get the 2.77% on top of the 3.8%, which compounds to 6.68% (1.038 × 1.0277 − 1). For GS employees, the memo lists four categories to be extended coverage: OPM says it plans to extend 6.68% to some non-GS positions as well: FP-1811 criminal investigators at the Department of Commerce and the Peace Corps, and non-supervisory SK-1811 criminal investigators at the Securities and Exchange Commission, the latter subject to consultation with OPM. Non-GS positions that received 3.8% in 2026 stay at 3.8%: the Secret Service Uniformed Division, Diplomatic Security Service agents and criminal investigators, U.S. Park Police, and National Nuclear Security Administration nuclear materials couriers. Separately, OPM is considering 3.8% special rates for Customs and Border Protection agricultural inspectors and certain firefighters. The memo describes these as protective positions rather than law enforcement occupations, and OPM staff will contact agencies for staffing data. Special rates cannot exceed level IV of the Executive Schedule, which stays at $197,200 in 2027 under the alternative pay plan. A second limit says the minimum rate of a special rate schedule for a grade cannot be more than 30% above the maximum basic pay otherwise payable for that grade, excluding locality pay. The memo warns that employees at or near either limit may see no increase, or less than 3.8% (current) or 6.7% (newly covered). For salary context, see the GS pay scale page. OPM says special rates are basic pay for most purposes, including retirement. The raise therefore feeds the High-3 average salary used to calculate a Federal Employees Retirement System (FERS) pension, not only take-home pay. The first illustration uses the basic FERS formula of 1% of High-3 for each year of service, with 30 years of service and a $90,000 High-3: Employees covered by the FERS special retirement provisions for law enforcement officers use a higher formula: 1.7% of High-3 for each of the first 20 years of service and 1% for each year after that. Coverage under those provisions is a separate question from special rate coverage, and the definitions differ, so check the position’s retirement coverage on OPM’s FERS computation page. For an employee with 25 years of service, the multiplier is 39%: Both illustrations assume the raise applies to the full 36-month High-3 window. For an employee retiring in 2027 or 2028, only part of the window includes the higher pay, so the effect is smaller at first and builds as more months at the new rate enter the average. The memo does not create a governmentwide raise. Under the alternative pay plan, most GS employees remain at 0% in January unless Congress acts. Retiree cost-of-living adjustments (COLAs) follow a separate statutory formula, and the 2027 figures are tracked on the COLA Watch page. title: 'Great sadness' as much-loved Welsh shop to close after 21 years - Tivyside Advertiser
content:
A local business supplying the community with news, stationary, a post office and everything from toys to cleaning products will close after two decades. GS News has been trading in Newcastle Emlyn for 21 years. The shop sells a bit of everything from Cymru hoodies to loo roll as well as books, toys and Welsh and English greeting cards. It also hosts the town’s post office which moved there from a location across the road in May, 2015. GS News in Newcastle Emlyn will close next month after 21 years (Image: Google Street View) GS News announced “with great sadness” that it is closing next month. The closure comes following the sad and sudden passing of co-owner Barry Rogers last April. The last day of GS News trading will be Monday, December 21. “I had very much hoped to be able to continue to keep the shop and Post Office open for the sake of the town and the townspeople,” said owner Sue Rogers in a post on social media. “It had been my intention to do so for as long as I could. "However, lately I have found it increasingly difficult physically to cope with the additional work and attendant stress, and now realise I simply have to slow down for my own well-being.” She added: “Barry’s sudden passing came as such a shock, and has made me realise we can’t take our health and longevity for granted.” She thanked her staff and customers for all their support and apologised for any inconvenience caused by the closure. “I am truly sorry for the huge void the closing of the Post Office will leave in the town, and wish things could be different,” she said. “I would like to say a huge thank you to all our loyal customers who have been such a big part of our lives. “I also want to thank our wonderful staff who are so hard-working and always cheery. “They have been such an amazing help and support, particularly in these last months, and I could not have got by without them.” GS News is currently in contact with the Post Office to discuss alternative accommodation for the service. title: Karol G’s concert takes a terrifying turn as cameraman falls in front of stunned fans - MARCA
content: Karol G’s concert takes a terrifying turn as cameraman falls in front of stunned fans The accident occurred during the singer's second performance in Monterrey, when one of the devices used to record the show got caught on the worker's backpack and lifted him several meters before causing him to fall. Karol G's concert in Monterrey had an episode no one expected. While the Colombian singer was performing her second show at Estadio BBVA, one of the cameramen on her production team ended up suspended in the air after getting snagged by a drone. The moment was recorded by several attendees and quickly began circulating on social media. The images show how the worker is suddenly lifted up and, seconds later, falls next to the stage. The accident caused concern among the spectators, who began asking what had happened and, above all, how the young man was doing. The incident occurred on Saturday November 7, 2026, during Karol G's second performance in Monterrey. At that moment, the artist was performing her song "Te llevas to" when an aerial camera apparently got caught on the backpack worn by one of the technical crew members. The force of the device lifted him several meters above the stage. However, the harness ended up coming loose and the cameraman fell into the space between the main structure and the seating area. Production staff rushed to help him after the accident. Another detail that drew attention was the singer's reaction. According to the footage released, Karol G had her back turned to the area where the accident occurred, so she apparently did not notice what was happening and continued performing the song. The show continued without interruptions, while attendees watched what had happened and shared the recordings on social media. The cameraman's health condition  is one of the main unknowns left by the accident. As of November 9, no official information had been released about the worker's identity, the possible injuries he suffered, or whether he needed medical attention after the fall. Although some social media posts began to mention possible fractures, that information has not been confirmed by the production team or by official sources. title: Goldman Sachs (GS.US) warns: U.S. stocks to face largest supply shock since 2000 in 2027 - 富途牛牛
content: Goldman Sachs strategists warn that the U.S. stock market bull run is entering its final countdown, with 2027 facing the largest net equity supply shock since the bursting of the internet bubble in 2000, while cracks in the AI narrative and deteriorating liquidity are exacerbating market volatility risk. According to Woofun AI, Tony Pasquariello, global head of Goldman Sachs (GS.US)'s hedge fund business, has issued a clear warning: although the main uptrend in the U.S. stock market has not yet been broken, it has entered a countdown; he expects the S&P 500 index to complete one final rally before a turning point, after which 2027 will face the largest net equity supply shock since the bursting of the internet bubble in 2000. The three core variables that have driven the strong performance of U.S. stocks over the past four years—earnings growth, capital flows, and the AI narrative—have all deteriorated in their marginal direction simultaneously. In his latest weekly report, Pasquariello notes that although Goldman Sachs forecasts S&P EPS could still grow by about 18% in 2027, and the S&P 500's second-quarter earnings growth reached 33% with third-quarter growth expected to hit 35%—the fastest pace in 30 years outside post-recession recoveries—the market is highly sensitive to changes in these rates. He emphasizes that the tension between the second derivative and the first derivative is becoming increasingly complex, making it ever harder to envision earnings delivering the kind of upward convexity that has characterized recent years. The more critical variable is that Goldman Sachs's earnings forecast is highly sensitive to AI capital expenditures, and this week's developments have significantly increased the downside risk to that forecast; with earnings growth peaking, upward momentum is becoming unsustainable. Signals from the capital flow perspective are even more alarming. According to data compiled by Woofun AI, over the past 20 trading days, hedge funds have been selling global AI stocks at their fastest pace in more than five years, deviating from the mean by more than three standard deviations, with this week's sell-off entering a state of "full-blown panic." Buyers have also collectively pulled back: weaker corporate buybacks, shrinking demand from overseas investors, and mechanical follow‑sell behavior by quantitative strategies such as CTA all combine to create a "buyer's strike." Even more concerning is the supply pressure looming in 2027: Pasquariello explicitly notes that net new equity supply in U.S. markets is expected to reach its highest level since 2000. The confluence of large IPO pipelines—including SpaceX (SPCX.US) and Anthropic—and a shift in corporate cash flows (with priority now given to funding capital expenditures over share repurchases) will exert simultaneous downward pressure on both the supply and demand sides. Although buyback volumes have rebounded to around $5 billion per day, and he remains relatively optimistic about liquidity over the final eight weeks of the year, this short-term support cannot mask the structural pressures looming in 2027. AI-driven narratives are showing cracks, and left-tail risks are expanding. Market consensus suggests that capital expenditure growth among tech giants will slow from 96% this year to 44% next year, while hyperscale cloud providers posted a net free cash outflow of $31 billion in the third quarter, fueling mounting concerns about their persistent negative free cash flow. Pasquariello notes that AI-related capex had previously served as "rocket fuel" for the market, but investors are now forced to seriously assess whether such aggressive spending can be sustained—introducing greater left-tail risk into a market that had until now focused almost exclusively on the right tail. Notably, in the same week, another Goldman Sachs strategist, Rich Privorotsky, also drew parallels between the current market cycle and the peak of the internet bubble in a report titled "1998 or 2000?" This suggests that within Goldman Sachs, there were two implicit references to the 2000 tech-stock crash during that single week. Privorotsky tends to liken the current correction to 1998 rather than 2000, viewing it as a liquidity event rather than the end of a cycle, but he also acknowledges that the unsettling similarities to 2000 lie in the sheer scale of spending and the uncertainty of returns. Meanwhile, this week the Nasdaq 100 index plunged as much as 6.36% in a single day, marking its biggest one-day drop since the COVID-19 pandemic, and hedge funds have nearly erased all their year-to-date gains. In terms of valuation, following this round of valuation cuts, the forward price-to-earnings ratios of both the Nasdaq 100 and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index have fallen below their levels prior to the November 2022 launch of ChatGPT—roughly four valuation multiples cheaper. The Nasdaq 100's forward P/E ratio has dropped to 18.4 times, the lowest since 2020. However, recently two investors he deeply respects told him that "the equity market is overly complacent relative to the credit market." With December rate hikes back on the table, AI‑related high‑yield bonds under pressure, and the largest net supply headwinds of 2027 looming, the credit market is already pricing in construction‑financing risks; whether the equity market has fully priced this in remains the key unanswered question. Tony Pasquariello's final conclusion is clear yet cautious: the primary bull-market trend remains intact, with a potential final surge before year-end; however, an "inflection point" has been factored into the outlook, suggesting that 2027 will bring a trading environment requiring "greater flexibility." As benchmark levels of index volatility trend higher, investors should be alert to the compression of upside convexity in AI‑infrastructure–related stocks and, amid worsening supply‑demand imbalances, reassess their portfolio allocations. title: Bengaluru to host first standalone Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians' conference on November 17-18 - The New Indian Express
content: BENGALURU: Bengaluru will host the first standalone Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians (CWP) India Region Conference in the country on November 17 and 18, bringing together around 150 women legislators from across India and representatives from 15-20 countries to deliberate on women's political leadership, cyber safety and capacity building. Announcing the event at a press conference at Vidhana Soudha on Monday, Karnataka Legislative Assembly Speaker G S Patil and Legislative Council Chairman Saleem Ahmed said the two-day event would provide a platform for women parliamentarians and legislators to discuss the challenges they face in public life and explore ways to strengthen their participation in legislative and decision-making processes. "This is a matter of pride for Karnataka. It is the first time that a standalone Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians conference of this nature is being organised in India, and Bengaluru has been chosen to host it," Patil said. The conference will be inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and Chief Minister D K Shivakumar. Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh, Deputy Chief Minister G Parameshwara and CWP India Region Chairperson D Purandeswari will also participate in the inaugural session. Around 150 delegates, including women MPs, MLAs, Members of Legislative Councils, Speakers and Deputy Speakers from various States and Union Territories, are expected to attend. Four women legislators from each State are expected to be represented. Representatives from 15-20 countries are also likely to participate. The conference will focus on two major themes — women's safety in the digital and cyberspace environment and strengthening the legislative skills and leadership capabilities of women representatives. The deliberations will cover cybercrimes against women, online harassment, digital abuse, misuse of artificial intelligence, deepfake technology, and protection of personal information and digital privacy. The discussions will also examine the challenges faced by women elected representatives in the digital environment. The second theme will focus on capacity building, including legislative procedures, lawmaking, policymaking, parliamentary debates, leadership development and the effective use of technology in legislative functioning. "Women's representation in legislative institutions is important, but it is equally necessary to strengthen their capabilities and ensure that they have a meaningful role in policymaking and governance. The conference will provide an opportunity to discuss the challenges faced by women legislators and share experiences," Saleem Ahmed said. He said the Karnataka Legislature had been asked to host the conference and the detailed agenda was being worked out in consultation with the Lok Sabha Secretariat and the CWP leadership. Purandeswari has constituted a committee of around 27-28 MPs, which has already held preliminary meetings in connection with the conference preparations, he said. The event will begin with the inaugural session at 11 am on November 17, at Banquet Hall in Vidhana Soudha, followed by deliberations after lunch. The valedictory session will be held at noon on November 18, with Governor Sudha Yadav participating. A curtain-raiser programme will be organised on November 14, with Chief Minister D K Shivakumar and CWP India Region Chairperson D Purandeswari unveiling the conference poster and outlining the preparations. Patil said Karnataka had accorded prominence to women's participation in public life and the conference would send a strong message on women's empowerment across the country. When asked about the absence of women in the State Cabinet, Patil said there were two  vacancies at present and women would be accommodated. As part of the conference-related programme, delegates will also be taken on a visit to Mysuru on November 19, including to Chamundi Hills. The conference is expected to provide a national and international platform to discuss ways of making legislative institutions more inclusive and strengthening women's leadership in democratic governance. title: NewPrinces Signs Hypermarket Lease-And-Sale Deal With Tosano - ESM Magazine
content: Italian retail conglomerate NewPrinces has signed an agreement with regional retailer Grupo Tosano to lease and potentially sell 15 large-format GS hypermarkets. Tosano will take over the operational management of the 15 stores, currently generating roughly €500 million in annual revenue and representing approximately 14% of GS’s total turnover of €3.5 billion. The transaction features a two-phase structure that includes long-term leases, purchase options, and a rent-to-buy scheme covering 13 GS-owned properties, carrying a total potential deal value of €453 million (excluding inventory). During Phase One, Tosano will lease the 15 units for five years, paying €110 million in lease fees alongside €5 million for option rights. The company will pay a further €10 million as either an advance on the eventual purchase price or as additional property usage fees. Should Tosano exercise an early withdrawal option by April 2029 (effective March 2031), the agreement limits total lease flows to GS to €75 million. If Tosano exercises the options by 30 June 2032, during Phase Two it will purchase the business units for €35 million (including the €10 million initial payment). Tosano will then enter a seven-year rent-to-buy agreement for 13 properties totalling €280.4 million in usage and advance payments, capped by a final property balance of €22.6 million due by June 2039. The overall agreed property valuation stands at €248.6 million, the company noted. Additionally, Tosano will purchase all store inventory upon handover, while GS will license its Euromercato brand as part of the deal. Management expects the deal to deliver a sub-consolidated EBITDA improvement of approximately €40 million annually in the first five years, and approximately €60.2 million annually in the years 6–12 upon full implementation of Phase Two. Moving forward, NewPrinces will focus on re-establishing the GS brand across mid-sized supermarkets, spanning 1,000 to 5,000 square metres, and expanding its high-growth GS Express convenience footprint across Italy. The transfer requires standard regulatory approvals, including clearance from the Italian Competition Authority (Autorità Garante della Concorrenza e del Mercato). POSCO and GS are joining forces to target the artificial intelligence data center (AIDC) market. They will combine POSCO’s steel materials and solutions with GS Group’s overseas sales and construction capabilities. Together, they aim to target the global data center market. According to industry sources on the 9th, POSCO and GS are pursuing business cooperation related to AIDCs. The partnership is expected to be formalized within this month. Although concerns about regulations on data center construction have grown since the recent U.S. midterm elections, the plan is to use the cooperation to strengthen each company’s business competitiveness and open up new markets to overcome sluggishness in existing demand industries. McKinsey & Company estimates that, of the investment needed to build AI data centers worldwide from 2025 to 2030, construction and development—including land, materials and site development—will amount to $800 billion (about 1,080 trillion won), while infrastructure—including power generation, transmission and cooling—will total $1.3 trillion (about 1,755 trillion won). This is a market that POSCO and GS, with their materials and energy supply capabilities, could seek to enter. Although the specific scope of the businesses and the projects involved have yet to be determined, areas of cooperation under consideration include supplying specialized steel products needed for data centers and power infrastructure, and identifying overseas projects, based on the companies’ existing businesses. POSCO established its Future Demand Development Office last July as part of its effort to become a specialized steelmaker covering AI- and power-related materials and solutions. The office serves as a control tower, moving beyond market responses organized by individual products to coordinate POSCO’s full range of products in response to demand across growth industries. Last month, POSCO separately formed an AIDC Demand Development Project Team and an ESS Specialized Solutions Project Team, and established a collaboration framework with affiliates including POSCO International, POSCO E&C and POSCO A&C. Drawing on experience with projects such as the Anyang Epoch Data Center, GS Engineering & Construction is building a business model that links investment, development, construction and operations. title: Upcoming BMW F 450 R & F 450 RR: Price Expectations - ZigWheels.com
content: BMW Motorrad recently launched the much-awaited Sport variant of the F 450 GS in India. It offers almost all the features of the top-spec Trophy variant without the ERC (Easy Ride Clutch) and at a slightly lower price of Rs 5.90 lakh (ex-showroom). However, that is still quite a premium for an adventure bike in the sub 500 cc category. The brand is also planning to bring the recently unveiled BMW F 450 R and F 450 RR to India by next year. Here’s what we expect them to cost. When BMW first unveiled the F 450 R and F 450 RR, we expected the streetfighter to be priced at around Rs 4.60 lakh, while the fully-faired RR was expected to cost Rs 4.75 lakh (both ex-showroom). However, things have changed since then, and both motorcycles are now expected to arrive with considerably higher price tags. The BMW F 450 R could be priced at around Rs 5 lakh, while the F 450 RR is expected to cost approximately Rs 5.20 lakh (both ex-showroom). The new expected pricing has been assumed as per the current pricing of the F 450 GS, as the F 450 R and F 450 RR are based on this adventure bike. This also means that their top-spec variants could easily touch the Rs 6 lakh mark, considering that the F 450 GS Trophy currently costs Rs 6.15 lakh (ex-showroom). For context, the Aprilia Tuono 457 is priced at Rs 3.99 lakh, while the fully-faired RS 457 costs Rs 4.26 lakh (both ex-showroom). This gives the Italian motorcycles a considerable price advantage even before the BMWs arrive. Another interesting fact is that the German brand will be manufacturing these new bikes in India. Considering this, we hope the brand keeps the pricing competitive rather than positioning these motorcycles at a significant premium over their Italian rivals. We also hope BMW introduces the non-ERC variants of both motorcycles right from the beginning, instead of bringing them to India several months after the initial launch. This would give buyers more affordable options and make the F 450 R and F 450 RR more accessible. Ultimately, BMW has some interesting motorcycles coming to India, but their pricing will play a crucial role in determining how well they compete against the Aprilia 457 twins. title: Reconguista in G's Gundam Base Exclusive G--Self Perfect Pack Gets Rare Online Release for Gundam Winter Fest 2026 - Essential Japan
content: A Gundam Base-exclusive version of the G-Self Perfect Pack is now available online for a limited time, with the movie-inspired Gunpla kit joining Bandai’s latest major promotional event. The “HG 1/144 THE GUNDAM BASE LIMITED G-SELF PERFECT PACK (Reconguista in G the Movie Ver.)” joins more than 200 Gunpla kits and related accessories available through Premium Bandai US for Gundam Winter Fest 2026, including a selection of normally store-exclusive Gundam Base models. G-Self first appeared in the 2014 anime Gundam Reconguista in G, which followed Bellri Zenam, a young Capital Guard cadet who became the pilot of the mysterious Mobile Suit during a conflict involving several competing factions in the Regild Century. Directed by Gundam creator Yoshiyuki Tomino, the series later received five theatrical compilation films released between 2019 and 2022, featuring revised animation, additional scenes, and changes to the original story. The G-Self Perfect Pack appeared during the latter stages of the story, combining equipment and capabilities associated with the Mobile Suit’s various backpack configurations into a single powerful system. Its specialized equipment allowed Bellri to switch between several combat modes, including the devastating Photon Torpedoes used during the conflict’s final battles. Bandai originally released the Gundam Base-exclusive High Grade kit in October 2024, introducing an updated version of the G-Self Perfect Pack based on its appearance in the theatrical films. The model builds upon the original “HG 1/144 Gundam G-Self (Perfect Pack Equipped)” from 2015, incorporating newly molded components across the head, chest, shoulders, and joints to improve its proportions, detailing and articulation. One of the most significant changes is the redesigned head, which more closely recreates the G-Self’s appearance in the movies, including its larger eyes that are recreated by new plastic stickers, revised sensors, and improved separation of the different armor colors. Its chest has also received substantial changes, including a newly molded transparent cover and improved detailing around the Beam Saber storage compartments. Additional articulation has been incorporated into the neck, shoulders and waist, allowing the upper body to bend and rotate more freely than the original High Grade release. The hip joints now feature a sliding mechanism that increases the range of movement in the legs, while adjustments to the elbows and knees provide greater flexibility for combat poses. The completed model retains the G-Self’s familiar blue, white and red coloring, with the transparent sections and updated stickers recreating the glowing Photon Battery details across its body. Its most prominent equipment is the Perfect Pack, a large backpack that combines several of the G-Self’s specialized systems through articulated binders, movable thrusters, and deployable weapons. The backpack supports multiple configurations, including Atmospheric Mode and Space Mode, with its equipment repositioned to recreate the different capabilities used throughout the story. Assault Mode can also be reproduced by extending the backpack’s weapon assemblies and adjusting the positions of its Traffic Fins, giving the G-Self a more heavily armed appearance. The kit also includes special effect parts for Reflector Mode, allowing builders to display the backpack’s energy-deflection equipment in its deployed configuration. Additional weapons include the Towasanga-produced Beam Rifle, Photon Armor Shield, and two Beam Sabers, with interchangeable hands provided for different combat poses. An Action Base 7 is included with the Gundam Base edition, providing additional support for the completed model and its large backpack during airborne displays. Builders can also assemble the G-Self without the Perfect Pack attached, with the kit including the necessary components to reproduce its standard Mobile Suit appearance. Another Gundam Base-exclusive kit available during Winter Fest is the “MG 1/100 Zaku Cannon (Z Gundam Ver.)”, which recreates the Earth Federation-operated Zaku Cannon from Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam with its alternative blue and purple coloring. That Master Grade is currently accepting limited-time US pre-orders through the same promotion, providing another opportunity to purchase a normally store-exclusive Gundam Base model online. Gundam Winter Fest 2026 runs from November 6 at 5:00 PM PST until November 30 at 11:59 PM PST, temporarily offering a large selection of Gunpla kits, Gundam Base limited models, and building accessories through Premium Bandai US. The “HG 1/144 THE GUNDAM BASE LIMITED G-SELF PERFECT PACK (Reconguista in G the Movie Ver.)” is currently in stock for $49, although quantities may be limited and the kit could sell out before the promotion concludes. title: Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 vs BMW F 450 GS Spec Comparison: What's Different? - Times Now
content: Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 and BMW F 450 GS compared. (AI-generated Image) The new Royal Enfield Himalayan bike is all set to enter the adventure segment in India. As the market is flooded with multiple options across different engine capacities and features, choosing the right one could be tough. One of its major rivals, the upcoming Himalayan 750, is the BMW F 450 GS, which has a smaller engine and a comparatively lighter package. The Himalayan 750 gets a 743cc parallel-twin engine, while the BMW F 450 GS comes with a 420cc parallel-twin unit. So, how do the two adventure bikes compare in terms of design, performance, hardware, and features? Let's take a look. The Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 comes in five colour options: Antarctic Silver, Siberia White, Viking Bronze, Aztec Green and Tectonic Black. The BMW F 450 GS, in contrast, is available in four variants with three distinct colour schemes. The Base and Exclusive variants come in Cosmic Black, while the newly introduced Sport variant adorns a Racing Red colour. The higher-spec GS Trophy variant is offered in Racing Blue Metallic with red and white accents. The F 450 GS has a 420cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin unit that makes 48hp and 43Nm at 8,750 rpm and 6,750rpm, respectively. It also has a six-speed transmission. The Himalayan 750 has the upper hand in displacement and torque. BMW offsets the lower displacement with a lighter overall package, giving the F 450 GS an advantage in terms of power-to-weight ratio. Both Royal Enfield and BMW Motorrad have opted for a 19-inch front wheel and a 17-inch rear wheel on their respective adventure bikes. That said, the major differences lie in wheel types rather than sizes. The former offers both cast-alloy and tubeless spoke-wheel options, while the latter gets cast-alloy wheels as standard. title: GS Boyz’s “Stanky Legg” Becomes A Chicago Bears Victory Signal - AllHipHop
content: A 2008 GS Boyz dance record has become the Chicago Bears’ locker-room victory signal as coach Ben Johnson keeps bringing it back. The Chicago Bears are carrying a 2008 Dallas rap dance into one of the NFL’s hottest locker rooms, where coach Ben Johnson’s version of the Stanky Legg now signals another win. Chicago beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 27-24 on Sunday night, improving to 7-2 with its fourth straight victory. The team posted another edition of Johnson’s locker-room speech after the game, extending a season in which the coach’s celebrations have become part of the weekly story. The dance started after Chicago’s 27-7 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on September 28. ESPN reported that Bears players were waiting for Johnson when he entered the locker room, leaving him to improvise. “Honestly, I had no idea. Those guys were waiting for me like that, and so I didn’t know what to do,” Johnson said. He rolled one leg, crossed an arm over his chest and gave the room a loose version of the dance that GS Boyz popularized with “Stanky Legg.” The basic move shifts the dancer’s weight before the extended leg rolls in a loose circle. Johnson remembered high school teammates doing it in the 2000s, while his players immediately treated the awkward first attempt as something worth repeating. The ritual survived beyond that Monday night win. Caleb Williams and other Bears joined Johnson after an October 22 victory over New England. Johnson added a stutter-step after Chicago beat Seattle on November 2, and players began waiting for the dance as part of the team’s established “Good, Better, Best” postgame chant. The Hip-Hop reference reaches back to Arlington, Texas, where GS Boyz turned “Stanky Legg” into a national dance record. Billboard reported in 2009 that the single sold 443,000 downloads, reached No. 17 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs and peaked at No. 49 on the Hot 100. Nearly two decades later, the record’s signature move has found another audience inside an NFL locker room. Johnson’s version is still more enthusiasm than precision, and Bears players have said it keeps improving. With Chicago entering the second half of its schedule at 7-2, every repeat now carries the same simple message: the team won again. title: Buick Is Still Building Sleek Sedans, Just Not for America - AOL.com
content: Buick last sold a sedan in the U.S. in 2020, when the Regal was discontinued. Since then, the brand has been selling only crossover SUVs in its home market, but things are quite different in Buick’s largest market—China. Buick currently sells four different sedans in China—Verano, Regal, Electra L7, and LaCrosse—and a fifth one will soon join their ranks. Buick is bringing back the Electra GS name in the guise of a sleek-looking plug-in hybrid sedan. Inspired by last year’s Electra GS Concept, the production model looks less striking, as it often happens when a design study reaches the production stage, but it’s still an eye-catching design. The first photos of the new Buick Electra GS come courtesy of China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (via CarNewsChina), which periodically publishes regulatory filings on upcoming automotive products. As you can see in the images, the Electra GS has a more traditional sedan shape than the 2025 concept, although the fastback roofline and smooth surfaces are still there. The plug-in hybrid sedan features slim headlights that wrap around a trim piece stretching across the front end; the element can be had either in body color or in silver. A similar trim piece is found at the rear flanked by the LED taillights and a light bar that spans the entire width of the car. Unlike the concept that featured flush door handles, the Electra GS features semi-hidden door handles to comply with the current safety legislation in China. The front bumper also has a gaping grille at the bottom, while the rear features an aggressive-looking lower bumper with two trim pieces sticking out on each side and flanking the license plate area. From a size standpoint, the Buick Electra GS measures 196 inches in length, which places it in Audi A6 territory. It’s around two inches shorter than the Electra L7, another sedan sold by Buick in China with battery electric and extended range electric powertrains. The GS is also 1.5 inches narrower and has a 5.3-inch shorter wheelbase than the L7. The Electra GS uses a plug-in hybrid powertrain consisting of either a 97-horsepower naturally aspirated 1.5-liter four-cylinder gas or a 154-hp turbocharged 1.5-liter. Each of the gas engines is paired with a front-mounted 221-hp electric motor powered by a lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery pack. Since both the ICE and the electric motor are placed on the front axle, all Electra GS variants are front-wheel-drive-only. The more powerful variant enables a top speed of 118 miles per hour. The battery capacity is not yet available, but the filing does note that there are two different suppliers for it: Rept Battero Energy and Zenergy. Built jointly with GM’s joint-venture partner SAIC, the Electra GS will enable Buick to compete with popular models like the BYD Qin L DM-i (known as the Seal 6 in Europe) and Geely Galaxy L6 in the Chinese market. Pricing and full specifications will be announced closer to the model’s launch. Since we’re talking about a model developed and built in China with software developed specifically for Chinese consumers, it goes without saying that Buick couldn’t sell the Electra GS in the United States even if it wanted to. content: Many automakers have different lineups for different regions, but one brand with arguably the most divergent lineups is Buick. In the US, we know it for upscale SUVs from subcompact to full-size, and they're all fairly conventional. You won't find any major electrification in any American Buick. Over in China, though, you can get SUVs, sedans, and even minivans with the brand, and you'll find all manner of hybridization and even full electric power. Now, Buick's Chinese division is about to get another hybrid in a sleek sedan package, and it has us wondering what's taking so long for American hybrids. This latest hybrid is another in the Electra line of cars, and it adopts the GS suffix that has long adorned Buick's highest-performance models. The brand hasn't officially introduced the model, but thanks to details being published by China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, we get an early (and extremely clear) look at it. It's a clean-looking thing with a nice low nose and a fastback roofline. Close examination of the rear shows a shut line that goes around the rear glass, suggesting it's a liftback, rather than a true sedan. It also has slim wraparound LED lighting at the front and back, and the diffuser section of the rear bumper reminds us a bit of the Porsche Taycan. While svelte, the Electra GS also looks a bit anonymous, as it follows the Chinese car design trend of going basically grille-less, but also not doing much with the front and rear fascias. The documents do show optional contrasting silver panels for the front and rear that add at least a bit of visual interest. The photos also show cameras on the fenders, and a lidar sensor on the roof. These won't be standard, though. Other images show roof and fender designs without driver assist components. Because of all the specifications included in the government documents, we also know how big the Electra GS is. It's 196 inches long, and it has a wheelbase of 112.8 inches. It's almost identical in size to the Toyota Crown, though its a little more than an inch shorter than Toyota's tall sedan. Despite the name, the Electra GS won't be much of a sports sedan. The documents show that it will be a plug-in hybrid, and at least one version of the car will feature a turbocharged 1.5-liter four-cylinder making 154 horsepower. It should also make 170 pound-feet of torque assuming it's the same engine that's used in the Electra E7 SUV. The electric motor is gutsier, making 221 horsepower, and, assuming the E7 connection, 243 pound-feet of torque. On the E7, Buick lists combined power and torque, but it simply adds the peak numbers together, which doesn't necessarily give an accurate picture of just how much propulsive power is provided. We would assume combined power is somewhere near the electric motor's output. It's adequate, but far from exhilarating. CarScoops reports that a base model will also be available with the lower-output powertrain from the E7. It uses a naturally-aspirated 1.5-liter four-cylinder making 97 hp and 96 pound-feet of torque. In the E7, that engine is still paired with the same 221-hp electric motor. Being a plug-in hybrid, the Electra GS will be able to charge up from the grid and operate fully electrically. Assuming that the powertrains are taken directly from the E7, it should get the same 32.6-kWh battery pack as the SUV. On China's test loop, that provides 146 miles of range. That would absolutely be lower on the US test cycle, but that's still a sizable battery and would likely provide plenty of range. The GS will probably go even further on a charge thanks to being more aerodynamic. Just like every other Chinese Buick, with the sole exception of the Envision, it's all but guaranteed the Electra GS won't come to America. Tariffs on Chinese vehicles, plus the cost of safety and emissions certification, on top of being a less-than-popular body style in our market make it a non-starter. Although it's possible it could show up in other markets, maybe even as close as Mexico, since Buick is looking to bring more of its Chinese models to other markets. The fact that Buick has added another hybrid to its already extensive roster does raise the question of what's taking so long for GM to bring hybrids back to the US. Emissions certification and production locations would be the main hindrances, just as it would be for a complete vehicle. GM does have hybrid plans for the US, though, as it's pouring money into a Michigan facility to build hybrid powertrains in the next few years, likely for its full-size SUVs that could include Buick's own Enclave. title: BMW F 450 GS Sport Launched At Rs 5.90 Lakh - DriveSpark
content: The BMW F 450 GS Sport has been launched in India at Rs 5.90 lakh (ex-showroom). The F 450 GS Sport is the fourth variant of the middleweight adventure motorcycle from BMW Motorrad and it comes with Sport Suspension and an exclusive Racing Red finish. Until now, the F 450 GS was sold in Base, Exclusive and GS Trophy variants. The new Sport slots in between the Exclusive and the GS Trophy, and is Rs 25,000 more affordable than the top-spec Trophy variant. When the BMW F 450 GS first went on sale in April, the Base was priced at Rs 4.70 lakh, the Exclusive at Rs 4.90 lakh and the GS Trophy at Rs 5.30 lakh. Prices have gone up since, and the range now starts at Rs 5.35 lakh. (All figures mentioned are ex-showroom). The new BMW F 450 GS Sport variant uses the same 420cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin as the rest of the range. The engine pushes out 48bhp at 8,750rpm and 43Nm at 6,750rpm through a 6-speed gearbox. BMW quotes an unladen weight of 178kg and a seat height of 845mm for the F 450 GS. Sport Suspension is the headline change in the BMW F 450 GS Sport, giving the ew variant a more focused setup than the standard Base and Exclusive variants. Gear Shift Assistant Pro is also standard, allowing clutchless gear changes under the right conditions. Riding Modes Pro adds an Enduro Pro setting to the existing Rain, Road and Enduro modes. Both the Sport and the GS Trophy get Sport Suspension and Riding Modes Pro. The Trophy adds BMW's Easy Ride Clutch, which isn't listed for the Sport, so the BMW F 450 GS Sport relies on a conventional clutch backed by Gear Shift Assistant Pro. The Trophy also has an aluminium engine guard and a tinted Rallye windscreen. With the arrival of the BMW F 450 GS Sport riders who wanted the Trophy's equipment without the Easy Ride Clutch now have that option. Racing Red paint is exclusive to the Sport. The X-shaped LED headlamp, front beak and upright proportions carry over from the other variants. title: BMW F 450 GS Sport Variant Launch Price Rs 5.90 Lakh - RushLane
content: At the time of its launch in India, the BMW F 450 GS was offered in three variants – Base, Exclusive and GS Trophy. BMW has now introduced a new Sport variant, positioned just below the top-spec GS Trophy variant. Priced at Rs 5.90 lakh, the new F 450 GS Sport variant is Rs 35,000 costlier than the Exclusive variant and Rs 25,000 more affordable than the GS Trophy variant. BMW has also expanded the broader 450 lineup with the F 450 R roadster and the F 450 RR faired versions. BMWF450GS Sport BMW is offering the F 450 GS Sport variant in an exclusive Racing Red colour option. This colourway predominantly combines shades of dark red and black, along with white and grey. With this new colour, the bike is now available with three colour options. The base and Exclusive variants are available in Cosmic Black colour. The GS Trophy variant is available in Racing Blue Metallic colour. F 450 GS Sport is essentially the GS Trophy, without the Easy Ride Clutch (ERC), which is available exclusively with the GS Trophy variant. Among enthusiasts planning to buy the BMW F 450 GS, the priorities can be broadly classified into ‘with ERC’ and ‘without ERC’. For the latter group, the new Sport variant ensures that all other features are accessible including the adjustable suspension. Sport variant’s Racing Red paintwork creates an exciting contrast and complements the bike’s sporty profile. Sharp design elements of the bike are better accentuated with this new colourway. The red shade is used largely across the front cowl, fuel tank and rear side panels. Rest of the surfaces are mostly black. The Sport variant also has distinctive graphics, combining themes in white and black. This paintwork also does a good job at accommodating the gold-finished USD forks. Coming to equipment, the new Sport variant of BMW F 450 GS has sport suspension, Gear Shift Assistant Pro, offroad footrests, clear windshield and hand protection. The Sport variant also has Riding Modes Pro (+Enduro Pro). As is evident, the Sport variant has most of the features available with the top-spec GS Trophy variant. Powering the F 450 GS is a 420cc twin-cylinder engine that produces 48 hp and 43 Nm of torque, paired with a 6-speed transmission. Ride modes include Rain, Road and Enduro. The bike uses a steel tube frame with the engine as a stressed member, along with a steel tube sub-frame. Suspension is 43 mm USD forks at the front and a monoshock at the rear. It rides on cast aluminium wheels, with disc brakes at both ends and ABS Pro. Key features include ride-by-wire, an anti-hopping clutch, dynamic traction control (DTC) and dynamic engine brake control (MSR). The tech kit includes a 6.5-inch colour TFT instrument display, and there are heated grips, a Type C USB port and Bluetooth connectivity. You also get one key for all the locks, an adjustable foot brake lever, an on-board computer, and adjustable clutch and handbrake levers.
